title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00044 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 00:15: Landed diverter.
00:15 - 04:30: R/d lifting equipment. Installed master bushing. M/u slick joint and installed tension cylinders. Meanwhile performed maintenance on drilling equipment.
04:30 - 05:30: Filled BOP and riser. Attempted to perform connector test to 310bar/10min. Pressure started to drop at 296 bar, stopped pumping. Trip tank steady during testing. Performed line test to 310bar/10min against kill valve on BOP, no leakages observed.
05:30 - 07:00: Evaluated situation. Meanwhile performed housekeeping on drill floor.
07:00 - 07:30: Prepared to retrieve BPV dart and plug. Lifted equipment to drill floor.
07:30 - 07:45: Performed TBT for retrieving BPV dart and plug.
07:45 - 08:00: P/u retrieval tool.
08:00 - 08:45: Attempted to m/u 3 1/2" DP. Changed dies carrier in aft IRN.

09:15 - 09:30: RIH with BPV retrieval tool to 19,9m. Retrieved BPV plug to surface.
09:30 - 10:15: Inspected BPV, no signs of damage. P/u new BPV plug and dart. RIH to 19,1m and installed BPV plug. POOH. RIH to 19,3m with dart and installed same. POOH.
10:15 - 10:30: Performed TBT for new connector test.
10:30 - 10:45: Performed line-up test to 20 bar.
10:45 - 11:15: Performed connection test to 20bar/310bar for 5/10min. Volume pumped from 20 bar to 310 bar, 60 ltrs. Bled back same.
11:15 - 11:45: RIH and retrieved dart and BPV plug. POOH.
11:45 - 12:00: B/o and l/o retrieval tool.
12:00 - 12:15: Performed TBT for r/u to pressure test TDS
12:15 - 12:45: M/u pump-in sub to TDS and connected cement hose.
12:45 - 13:00: Performed TBT for pressure testing TDS.
13:00 - 15:15: Pressure tested lower and upper IBOP, kelly hose and s12 valve to 310bar/10min. R/d pump-in sub and cement hose.
15:15 - 15:45: Prepared hoses and equipment for THRT. Meanwhile installed lifting tool in FWD PRS. Tightened fittings on FWD PRS.
15:45 - 17:00: R/u casing handling equipment

sections.text: Landed diverter.
R/d lifting equipment. Installed master bushing. M/u slick joint and installed tension cylinders. Meanwhile performed maintenance on drilling equipment.

Filled BOP and riser. Attempted to perform connector test to 310bar/10min. Pressure started to drop at 296 bar, stopped pumping. Trip tank steady during testing. Performed line test to 310bar/10min against kill valve on BOP, no leakages observed.
Evaluated situation. Meanwhile performed housekeeping on drill floor.
Prepared to retrieve BPV dart and plug. Lifted equipment to drill floor.
Performed TBT for retrieving BPV dart and plug.
P/u retrieval tool.
Attempted to m/u 3 1/2" DP. Changed dies carrier in aft IRN.
RIH with dart retrieval tool to 19,7m. Made 3 attemptes. Released and retrieved dart.
RIH with BPV retrieval tool to 19,9m. Retrieved BPV plug to surface.
Inspected BPV, no signs of damage. P/u new BPV plug and dart. RIH to 19,1m and installed BPV plug. POOH. RIH to 19,3m with dart and installed same. POOH.
Performed TBT for new connector test.
Performed line-up test to 20 bar.
Performed connection test to 20bar/310bar for 5/10min. Volume pumped from 20 bar to 310 bar, 60 ltrs. Bled back same.
RIH and retrieved dart and BPV plug. POOH.
B/o and l/o retrieval tool.
Performed TBT for r/u to pressure test TDS
M/u pump-in sub to TDS and connected cement hose.
Performed TBT for pressure testing TDS.
Pressure tested lower and upper IBOP, kelly hose and s12 valve to 310bar/10min. R/d pump-in sub and cement hose.
Prepared hoses and equipment for THRT. Meanwhile installed lifting tool in FWD PRS. Tightened fittings on FWD PRS.
R/u casing handling equipment, dressed for 7".
Performed TBT for RIH with THRT and landing string.
P/u and m/u tubing hanger running tool. M/u and RIH with landing string. POOH. M/u control lines and flushed same.
Lined-up to pressure test kill manifold.
Pressure tested kill manifold test) 20/345bar for 5/10min.
RIH with THRT to 21m and landed on th. Orientated j-slot 90 deg. Took 2 ton overpull. Applied 14 21 bar on tool, string dropped approx. 2". Engaged communication collar by turning string 8 turns LH.
Rigged up hose on a-annulus wing on multibowl. Meanwhile changed elevator.
Performed TBT for installing swedge and open DHSV
Changed fittings on hose for elevator due to leakage.
Inspected swedge and found mark on seal face. Filed sealface. M/u swedge on 7" landing string.
Installed cement hose and lo-torque valve. Pressure same to 100bar.
Applied 520 bar on DHSV control line. Pressured up tubing with rig pumps. DHSV opened at 75 bar. Bled down pressure through mud-gas separator. Monitored for pressure build up for 5 min.
